micro generator.d: Adds 1 extra combat stat (attack, defense, armor, damage, HP) to each equipped item, providing the item already has at least 1 increase in the relevant stat, for each level your character is above the item's level. The maximum bonus is determined by the skill level: for each 25 points, one level is added to the maximum limit.
micro generator.e: Maximum bonus at this level: {L/25} per combat stat.

scavenger.d: Increases chance of success when getting resource items.

mind orb.d: 50% (+0.25% per point) chance to fill an empty 'Mind Orb', allowing it to be used as ammo.
x: Needs Psionic Sensitivity and Mind Stone

accelerator.d: Gives an XP / Energy multiplier. If it is active together with Intensifier, only the highest XP / Energy multiplier is used - they are not combined. (Full description not available.)
